summary: A CC0 Dryad dataset covers 955 bird species with egg size, elongation and asymmetry plus oviduct and pelvis files and a phylogeny; the Amniote database adds adult and female body mass and egg dimensions for many birds. Column-level contents of the Dryad CSVs were not read because file downloads require a token, so body mass and the overlap of oviduct data with the 955 species remain to be confirmed.
next_step: Download the Dryad files in a browser, confirm columns for egg volume, asymmetry, female body mass and oviduct, join to the Amniote database by binomial, and pre-register the relative-egg-size versus asymmetry test.
obstacles_confirmed: Oviduct dimension files are small (4.5 KB and 2.2 KB) and no oviduct pressure data were found.
Dryad file downloads need an API token; metadata and file names were readable.
The assessor URL esapubs E090/184 is PanTHERIA, not the Amniote database.
